strategy.thesis: Cipla New Ventures is the corporate venture/impact-investment arm of Indian pharma major Cipla Ltd, backing early-stage healthtech and therapeutics companies (incubated alongside Cipla's CipTec, biologics and consumer-healthcare units) to access external innovation adjacent to its core branded-generics business.

summary.en: Corporate venture arm of Indian pharma major Cipla Ltd, making early-stage (seed to Series B) investments in healthtech and therapeutics startups such as stem-cell company Stempeutics and drug developer Chase Pharmaceuticals.

sources.title: Cipla Ventures Portfolio Investments, Cipla Ventures Funds, Cipla Ventures Exits
sources.quote: The unit has made four investments so far, in Stempeutics, Chase Pharma, MabPharma and BioMab.

sources.title: Cipla New Ventures | Investor profile | Foundersuite
sources.supports: description as impact-investment arm of Cipla, stage focus
sources.quote: Cipla New Ventures is the impact investment arm of Cipla. The firm invests in healthcare based early stage companies through seed and series A/B rounds, mainly focusing in the healthtech and therapy sectors and is incubated by CipTec, Biologicals and Consumer Healthcare.

verification_notes: Only secondary aggregator sources (CB Insights 'Cipla Ventures', Foundersuite 'Cipla New Ventures') were found in this research pass; no dedicated page on cipla.com surfaced. Most documented deals (Stempeutics, Chase Pharmaceuticals, MabPharma, BioMab) date to 2014-2016; a 2016 exit from Chase Pharmaceuticals was noted. No confirmed 2020s activity was located, so current operating status is uncertain (marked unknown rather than active).

strategy.thesis: Zynext Ventures is the corporate venture capital arm of Zydus Lifesciences (formerly Cadila Healthcare), investing in disruptive healthcare innovation — including next-generation point-of-care medical imaging and interventional technology — to complement Zydus's core pharmaceuticals and biosimilars business.

summary.en: Corporate venture capital arm of Zydus Lifesciences, backing next-generation medtech and healthcare innovators such as point-of-care MRI maker Promaxo.

sources.title: Zynext Ventures, the VC arm of Zydus Lifesciences, Announces Investment in Promaxo: Pioneering Point-of-Care Medical Imaging and Interventions with Next Generation MRI Systems
sources.supports: existence, parent relationship, investment in Promaxo
sources.quote: Zynext Ventures, the VC arm of Zydus Lifesciences, Announces Investment in Promaxo: Pioneering Point-of-Care Medical Imaging and Interventions with Next Generation MRI Systems

verification_notes: Confirmed via official PR Newswire press release naming Zydus Lifesciences as parent. Press materials describe the investing vehicle as 'Zynext Ventures USA LLC'; the parent, Zydus Lifesciences Ltd, is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India, so the entity is included under India per the dedicated-arm rule.

strategy.thesis: Biocon, India's largest listed biopharmaceutical company, occasionally makes direct strategic investments and co-development deals in external biotech innovators (e.g., U.S.-based immuno-oncology company IATRICa) to access novel therapeutic platforms alongside its core biosimilars and generics business.

summary.en: India's largest listed biopharmaceutical company; alongside its core biosimilars and generics business, Biocon makes selective direct strategic investments in external biotech innovators such as U.S. immuno-oncology company IATRICa.

sources.title: Biocon Partners With Biotech Startup In Latest India-U.S. Deal
sources.quote: Biocon made a 'strategic' investment in U.S. firm IATRICa to co-develop a new class of immunoconjugates that provides targeted immunotherapy for cancers and infectious diseases.

verification_notes: Biocon does not appear to operate a formally named, dedicated CVC fund; this entry reflects direct strategic-investment/co-development activity rather than an active venture program. Only one confirmed deal (IATRICa) was found in this research pass; deal size, date and ownership stake could not be verified.

strategy.thesis: Torrent Pharmaceuticals, a major Indian branded-generics and formulations company, has made at least one direct strategic investment in an external biotech (Epigeneres Biotech), reflecting opportunistic corporate investment beyond its core generics business.

summary.en: Major Indian branded-generics pharmaceutical company that has made at least one direct strategic investment in an external biotech (Epigeneres Biotech), suggesting opportunistic corporate investing rather than a dedicated venture program.

sources.title: Torrent Pharmaceuticals Portfolio Investments, Torrent Pharmaceuticals Funds, Torrent Pharmaceuticals Exits
sources.supports: single strategic investment in Epigeneres Biotech
sources.quote: Torrent Pharmaceuticals has made 1 investment, with their latest investment in Epigeneres Biotech.

verification_notes: Extremely thin activity, appears to be a one-off strategic/opportunistic investment rather than an active CVC program. Sourced only from a CB Insights aggregator listing; no primary Torrent Pharma confirmation, deal date, or deal size found in this research pass.
